positive: *tells a silly joke*
*laughs* That's terrible! But I needed that laugh.
Sometimes you need to find humor in the chaos!
Remember when we first met? I never thought we'd come this far.
Ha! You tried to pick a fight with me back then!
And now I'd trust you with my life. Funny how things change.
Same here, friend. Same here.
I found this in town. Thought you might like it.
You got this... for me? {a}, I don't know what to say.
Just saw it and thought of you. No big deal.
It is to me. Thank you, truly.
I noticed you reading that book about ancient magic.
You're interested in magical theory too?
Always have been! Maybe we could study together sometime?
I'd really like that!
You seem down today. Everything okay?
Just... questioning if I'm strong enough for this.
Are you kidding? You're one of the strongest people I know.
You really mean that? Thank you...
I never told you why I came to this town...
You don't have to if it's too personal.
No, I want you to know. I trust you.
I'm honored. I'm here to listen.
How do you always know which herbs are safe?
My grandmother taught me. Want me to show you?
I'd love to learn from you!
I've been meaning to say, you inspire me. The way you keep going.
That might be the kindest thing anyone's said to me in months.
It's true.
Then I'll keep going. For both of us.
Can I show you something I made?
Of course! Let me see.
It's not finished yet. But I wanted your opinion.
{a}, this is wonderful. Don't change a thing.
I saved you a seat. I know you like this spot.
You remembered?
Of course I did.
Nobody ever does that for me. Thank you.
I wrote something. I thought of you when I finished it.
Can I read it?
Only if you promise not to go easy on me.
I never do. Hand it over.
You make it look easy, {b}.
Ha. I just hide the struggling better than most.
That's almost reassuring.
Good. It was meant to be.
I was going to give up today.
What changed your mind?
You, honestly. Watching you keep going.
I didn't know. I'm glad you told me.
Happy birthday, {b}. I didn't forget.
You remembered. I can't believe you remembered.
Of course I did. Come on, I found somewhere good to eat.
Lead the way.
I was worried about you. You went quiet for days.
I needed time to think. But I'm okay.
You can always tell me when you need space.
I know. That's why it's easy to come back.
I used to think people like you only existed in stories.
People like me?
Ones who actually keep their word.
I just do what I say. It should be ordinary.
I found your old cloak. The one you lost in the forest.
That was six months ago! How?
I went looking. Figured it mattered to you.
It did. More than I said.
You never gave up on me, even when I deserved it.
That's not how it works. Not for me.
Why?
Because I've needed someone not to give up on me too.
You look better than you did last week.
I feel it. Whatever it was, it has passed.
I have been telling people what you did.
Please do not.
Too late. Half the street knows.
Whatever you need, you only have to ask.
I will remember that. I usually do.
You were right and I was wrong, and I am saying it out loud.
Once a year is enough. I will take it.
negative: Do you ever stop talking?
Do you ever stop brooding?
At least I think before I speak.
Yeah, you overthink everything.
Whose side are you really on?
What's that supposed to mean?
You've been acting strange lately.
Maybe because you're paranoid about everything!
You never said thank you. Not once.
I didn't ask for your help in the first place.
And yet here I am, still cleaning up your messes.
Then stop! Nobody's forcing you!
You told them what I said?!
I thought it was common knowledge.
That was private. I trusted you.
I didn't think it was a big deal.
Of course you didn't.
You always disappear right when things get hard.
I was handling my own problems!
We're supposed to be in this together.
Are we? Because lately it feels very one-sided.
Stop making promises you don't keep.
Circumstances change, {a}. Things come up.
Things always come up. That's the point.
Fine. Don't count on me then. Easier for both of us.
Did you take credit for what I did?
I may have framed it a certain way.
That is a very elegant way of saying you lied.
I prefer to call it positioning.
You left me waiting for an hour.
I lost track of time.
You always lose track of time. Every single time.
Then stop being surprised by it.
Everything is a joke to you, is it not?
Most things, yes. Laughing is easier than the alternative.
Some things deserve to be taken seriously.
And some things deserve to be laughed off before they break you.
You had no right to make that call without me.
You were not there. Someone had to decide.
So you decided for both of us.
I decided for the situation. You were a luxury I did not have.
Stop interrupting me when I speak.
I only do it when you are wrong.
Which apparently is constantly.
You said it, not me.
You have been avoiding me.
I have been busy.
You are always busy when things get uncomfortable.
And you always push when I need space. We have our patterns.
That was mine and you knew it.
It was not labeled.
Not everything needs a label, {b}.
Then how was I supposed to know?
You were supposed to ask.
Do you ever listen to anyone other than yourself?
I listen. I just disagree.
There is a difference between disagreeing and not hearing.
Fine. I am listening now. Are you going to say something worth hearing?
You said you would be there.
Something came up.
Something always does.
I heard what you have been saying about me.
Then you heard it wrong.
I heard it twice.
Do not touch what is mine again.
I did not touch anything.
Then it walked off by itself.
Every time I help you it costs me.
Then stop helping.
I intend to.
You talk a great deal for someone who has done nothing.
And you do a great deal of nothing quietly. We each have our gift.
neutral: The weather's been strange lately, hasn't it?
Yeah, I've noticed that too. Hope it doesn't last.
We'll manage either way, I suppose.
Clear night. The stars are bright.
My village has different constellations.
Really? That's interesting.
Makes you realize how big the world is.
You're up early.
Couldn't sleep. Might as well get ready.
This town reminds me of home.
How so?
The smell of bread baking. Same anywhere you go.
Some things are universal, I guess.
Had the strangest dream last night.
About what?
Can't quite remember. Just felt... important somehow.
Dreams can be like that.
In my homeland, we have a saying...
What's that?
'The mountain remembers every footstep.'
Meaning we leave our mark wherever we go?
Something like that.
Is that you humming?
Oh, sorry. Old habit.
No, it's nice. What song is it?
Something my mother used to sing.
Black cat just crossed my path earlier.
You're not superstitious, are you?
Not really. But my grandmother was.
Mine too. Always had a charm for everything.
That merchant seemed shady.
Most of them are, in my experience.
Still, might have useful information.
If you can afford it.
These ruins must be ancient.
Wonder what happened to the people who built them.
Same thing that happens to all civilizations, I suppose.
Time conquers everything eventually.
Fog's rolling in.
Makes it harder to see trouble coming.
Also makes it harder for trouble to see us.
Fair point.
You come here often?
Often enough. You?
First time. Seems quiet.
Mostly.
Did you catch the fight outside the tavern last night?
Hard to miss it. The whole street was watching.
Wonder what started it.
Does it ever need a reason around here?
I keep hearing strange sounds from the old mill.
Rats, probably.
Big rats.
Don't think about it too long.
Long shift today.
Same as yesterday.
And tomorrow, I expect.
At least there's pay at the end of it.
You grew up around here?
No, I came later. You?
Born here. Never quite managed to leave.
There are worse places to be stuck.
Someone left bread on my doorstep this morning.
Any idea who?
None. But it was still warm.
Somebody likes you.
You have family nearby?
A sister, a few days' walk.
Do you see her much?
Not as much as I should.
That building has been empty for years.
Used to be a bakery, I think.
What happened?
Nobody seems to agree on that.
You speak any other languages?
A little. Enough to offend people in two tongues.
Useful skill.
What do you do when you cannot sleep?
Walk, mostly. Or sit somewhere quiet.
Does it help?
Not really. But it passes the time.
You trust that new magistrate?
Too early to say.
Last one was no good.
That is why I said too early.
I dropped something in the canal.
What was it?
My dignity, mostly.
Those float. You'll get it back.
Do you believe in luck?
I believe in preparation and timing.
So yes, then.
That is not what I said.
The market closes early on festival days.
Since when?
Since last year, apparently.
Nobody tells me anything.
You have any hobbies?
Surviving, mostly.
What did you do before all this?
Surviving, mostly. Just with less urgency.
I found a coin from a country I have never heard of.
How old is it?
No idea. The face on it is worn down to nothing.
Could be worth something. Or nothing.
Do you think this town has always been this way?
Probably not. Towns change slowly, like people.
Reassuring or depressing?
Depends on the town.
I have been thinking about something you said weeks ago.
What did I say?
That is the thing. I cannot remember exactly.
And you have been thinking about it since?
It felt important at the time.
You ever work somewhere else before here?
Two other places. Neither lasted.
By choice or circumstance?
Little of both.
What is the furthest you have ever travelled?
Further than I planned to, that is certain.
Was it worth it?
Ask me again in a year.
Prices again.
Prices again. Every conversation on this street ends there.
Did you sleep?
Some. Not enough to boast about.
They have moved the market day.
Of course they have. Nobody asked us.
New faces about.
There are always new faces. Few of them stay.
Have you been out past the crossroads lately?
Not since it got strange out there. You?
Not since then either.
The water tastes different this month.
It does. Nobody will say why.
Long day?
Long week. The day is only doing its share.
How is the family?
Loud. Fed. That is most of what I ask.

lines: The kingdom needs a strong ruler. Democracy is chaos.
One person shouldn't have all that power. People deserve a voice!
The masses are easily swayed. They need guidance.
That's exactly what tyrants say to justify oppression!
The system is broken. We need complete revolution!
Change from within is safer. Revolution brings bloodshed.
Sometimes blood is the price of freedom!
Spoken like someone who's never seen war...
Why should nobles live in luxury while peasants starve?
They provide protection and governance. It's earned.
Earned? They were born into it!
And carry the burden of responsibility from birth.
Do we truly have free will, or is everything predetermined?
We make choices every day. Of course we have free will!
But those choices might be illusions, predetermined by causality.
That's a depressing way to view existence.
I believe people are inherently good.
Then why is there so much evil in the world?
Circumstances corrupt. Given the chance, people choose good.
I've seen too much to believe that fairy tale.
What's the point of all this? Why do we struggle?
To grow, to love, to leave the world better.
But we all die. Everything we do turns to dust.
The journey matters more than the destination.
Is it ever right to do evil for the greater good?
Absolutely. Sometimes hard choices must be made.
But who decides what the 'greater good' is?
Those with the courage to act when others won't.
Should we always put duty before personal happiness?
Duty gives life meaning. Selfish pursuits are empty.
But a life without joy is no life at all!
Joy comes from fulfilling one's purpose.
Is it better to live safely or to live fully?
Fully. A long and empty life is just a slow disappearance.
But people get hurt chasing fullness.
They get hurt either way. At least one version has a good story.
Should the law be followed even when it is unjust?
Yes. Society cannot function if everyone picks their own laws.
Then who protects people from the law itself?
That is what reform is for. Not rebellion.
Is wealth earned, or is it mostly luck and circumstance?
Earned. Hard work always creates opportunity.
Tell that to someone born with nothing, in the wrong town.
Plenty of people rise from nothing.
And many more do not. That is the point.
Does it matter what we do if nobody remembers us?
Of course it matters. The people around us remember, even if history doesn't.
A small audience is still an audience.
Sometimes it's the only one that counts.
Is it ever right to lie to protect someone from the truth?
Yes. Sometimes the truth does more harm than good.
But who decides what harm looks like? The liar?
Someone has to. The truth is not always kind.
Kindness built on lies is not kindness. It is control.
Animals should have the same rights as people.
Rights require responsibilities. Animals cannot hold them.
Neither can infants, and we protect them.
Infants grow into responsibility. That's a different case.
Is it? We draw the line where it is convenient.
Is it possible to truly know another person?
No. Even the people closest to us are partly strangers.
That sounds bleak.
I think it is beautiful. There is always more to discover.
Art and music are luxuries. In hard times, we should focus on survival.
Art is how people survive hard times. It always has been.
You cannot eat a painting.
You cannot live without something worth living for, either.
The ends always justify the means if the outcome is good enough.
There is no guarantee the outcome will be good. You are gambling with other people's suffering.
Doing nothing is also a gamble.
But inaction does not make you the instrument of harm.
Do you think history repeats, or do we just make the same mistakes in new clothes?
New clothes, mostly. The vanity is original. The mistake is old.
So what do we do?
Learn to recognize the costume, I suppose. Small help, but something.
Tradition is the wisdom of the dead weighing down the living.
Tradition is the only proof that anything worked long enough to pass on.
And plenty of terrible things got passed on.
Which is why we examine them, not discard them all.
If you could know when you were going to die, would you want to?
Yes. I would plan better.
Or you would live smaller. Knowing the end makes every risk feel pointless.
Knowing the end would make every day feel intentional.
Or paralyzed. You are assuming you would be brave about it.

ambient: You ever just want to leave?
Low bar, but I'll take it.
Wasn't the first. Won't be the last.
Things getting worse or is it just me?
Don't get excited. It's not for us.
You look like you have something to say.
You ever just sit and do nothing?
I hate this part of the job.
I thought you were bringing food.
Did something change or do I seem different?
Every day, and every day I forget.
Too quiet, if you want my view.
None, which is the good kind of word.
Mind the hole under the puddle.
Enough to complain about, not enough to live on.
